ponta-pass-design.label: Pontaパス design system (Web/Android/iOS): tokens, components, templates, and bundled assets from the existing screens; installed from a local copy
ponta-pass-design.adapter: Bounded adapter, not full upstream execution. This choice changes an existing product, so refined-mockups works on a copy of the product's exported screen set, the design baseline `ponta-pass`, through `bun <harness dir>/tools/ui-poc-baseline.cjs <command> --stage-dir <this stage's record directory> --name ponta-pass`. 1) Baseline. Run `status`, then ask the person through AI-DLC's pending-question flow, never a separate prompt. When the space has a baseline the choices are: use the space's Pontaパス baseline (recommended), or give another folder. When it has none, ask for the absolute path of their exported Pontaパス screen folder (where it lives and what it is called differ per person). For a given folder when the space already has a baseline, ask once more: use it for this intent only, or replace the space baseline. Then run `adopt --from <folder>` (no baseline yet; add `--replace` when they chose to replace it) followed by `start`, or `start --from <folder>` for this intent only, or `start` for the space baseline. When the tool refuses a folder, say its one-line reason and ask again. Never take a folder from PONTA_PASS_EXPORT, the skill's default ~/Downloads folder, or an earlier run, and never record the folder path. `start` copies the whole set into `ponta-pass/` in this stage and records every file's hash; a later run keeps that copy. 2) Read before changing. Follow the skill's SKILL.md steps 1-2 against the copy: choose the platform (web, android, or ios) and, for Web, the style F1-F14 from the creator-confirmed brief and approved requirements (when they leave it open, ask through the pending-question flow); read the matching references/<platform>.md; and read the screens the change touches, with their Spec-, CR-, Flow- and Screen-02-member pages, through `python3 -I .agents/skills/ponta-pass-design/scripts/ref.py <command> <this stage>/ponta-pass <ID>`, always passing the copy as ref.py's first argument. 3) Change the copy in place. For every page you change or add, run `unpack --file <page>`, edit the HTML it writes under `ponta-pass-work/`, then `pack --file <page>`; never edit a bundled page's text directly. A new screen starts from a copy of the closest existing page of the same platform, named in the set's own `<Platform>-NN-<id>.html` form. Change, in the same set and where the change reaches them: the screens, each changed or added screen carrying a visible 変更 or 新規 badge in its page note; their screen specifications (`Spec-<screen>.html`: elements el-NNN, display states, validation, destinations, APIs; a new screen gets a new Spec page); one change request sheet per changed screen (`CR-<NNN>-<screen>.html` in the set's CR format, each element 既存, 既存改修, 新規実装 or 削除); the screen transition and flow diagrams (`Flow-00-transition`, `Flow-01-journeys-v2`, `Flow-02-screen-map`, `Flow-03-userflow`); the screen list, hub and member-type pages (`Screen-00`, `Screen-01`, `Screen-02-member`); and `_index.html`, linking every changed page. Build from the skill's templates, components, CSS-variable tokens chosen by role, and bundled images; never redraw logos or characters. Check every changed screen with `python3 -I .agents/skills/ponta-pass-design/scripts/check.py --strict <platform> <html>` and fix each value not found in the existing screens, or list it as 既存に無い値. 4) Declare every change. Run `diff`. Write `ponta-pass-changes.json` with `files.added`, `files.modified` and `files.deleted` exactly as diff reports them; `screens`, one entry per changed screen page with `file`, `status`, `spec`, `cr`, `refined` (its refined contract page) and `elements` (each with `id` el-NNN, `change` 既存改修, 新規実装 or 削除, and `summary`); and `flows`, each changed diagram with a one-line summary. Write `ponta-pass-changes.md` for the person from the same facts: the baseline source and its hash, the changed files, each screen's element changes, and the diagram changes, each linking to its page. 5) Refined contract pages. Only changed and added screens get a refined contract page under `refined/`: that screen made self-contained with `python3 -I .agents/skills/ponta-pass-design/scripts/bundle.py <in> <out>`, with data-ui-screen and data-ui-state on its render root and its el-NNN IDs as data-ui-id, captured like any refined state. Unchanged screens need none. 6) Run `verify`. It fails on a change not declared, a declared change that did not happen, an unpacked page left behind, and a changed screen without its entry, element changes, or refined page; fix and rerun until it passes. Record the reference screen IDs, the platform and style, the check result, and the 既存に無い値 list in the stage's design notes. The creator-confirmed brief wins where it conflicts with the skill; record the conflict. AI-DLC owns files, stable screen/state/AC IDs, the refined contract, and approval.
